responsibility: Defines the shared `rustc_const_eval::util` surface by wiring together utility submodules, re-exporting their helper APIs, and classifying MIR binary operators by whether operand and result types are homogeneous.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is a narrow utility facade: it wires together helper submodules and provides MIR binop homogeneity classification helpers. It does not define a transform entry point like `transform/mod.rs`, a const-checking context like `transform/check_consts/mod.rs`, an interpreter API root like `interpret/mod.rs`, or CTFE query/evaluation glue like `const_eval/mod.rs`.
